parole.testo: Unknown. Possible origins include: * Hebrew בָּחוּר (bakhúr, “Jewish child; piglet”); * Arabic البُكْس (al-buks, “young camel; veal”); * Arabic بُكَيْرَة (bukayra), diminutive of بَكْرُن (bakrun, “bull”); * a Germanic word related to French bacon; * Medieval Latin bacharus. Cognate with Galician bác
